findings.title: filterBy rendered-visibility test missing
findings.problem: Spec section 10 explicitly requires a test that asserts an option whose value (technical name) matches the search query but whose displayName does NOT match remains visible in the rendered dropdown. The current tests mock the MultiSelect component and only verify the data-filter-by attribute value — they cannot detect a PrimeReact regression where the filterBy prop is accepted but silently ignored at runtime.
findings.impact: A future PrimeReact upgrade or misconfiguration that breaks filterBy='value,displayName' client-side filtering would pass all existing tests. This is the core regression guard for EPMCDME-13637's fix: if PrimeReact stops matching by value, projects become invisible by technical name again with no test failing.
findings.recommendation: Add a test that renders the real PrimeReact MultiSelect (without mocking @/components/form/MultiSelect) with two options — one whose value matches the typed query and one that does not, where the matching option's displayName does NOT contain the query string. After simulating the user typing the query into the filter input, assert the matching option is visible via getByText or queryByRole('option', ...). Place in a separate test file (e.g. MultiSelect.filterBy.test.tsx) to avoid conflicting with existing mocks.
